title: A Houston Seminar on Human Experience in AI, Robotics, and XR
summary: Park's seminar announcement brought trust, accessibility, and everyday technology use into an interdisciplinary conversation.

University of Houston Computer Science seminar listing

paragraphs.text: On April 23, 2026, Chorong Park announced a seminar for the University of Houston Department of Computer Science. The department's calendar lists the talk for April 24 at 11 a.m. in PGH 563.

The announced talk, "Bridging Technology and Human Experience in AI, Robotics, and XR," focused on the importance of human-centered design in interactive technologies. Park proposed looking beyond technical capability to consider whether systems are usable and trustworthy in real settings.

Her planned discussion connected human-computer and human-robot interaction with aging, care, privacy, and adoption. The announcement offered a meeting point for researchers across disciplines working on how technology fits into people's lives.
